limitations: Approximate current exterior and fit from inspected entrance picture and standard viewer PMTiles; no bespoke survey or exact thresholds.
Detailed original master/hash/recipe preserved. Spire/dome profiles, columns, inscriptions and restoration details are interpreted; interiors and collision excluded.

Six common graphs plus explicit glass color slot; zero embedded images. A reversible bounded ground opening and authored paved apron suppress the PMTiles mound under the palace; adjacent raw PMTiles terrain is retained. Actual urban ground datum is not surveyed.
Footprint replacement remains off; physical-device timing unmeasured.

currentRoundInspection.method: Reference picture pixels inspected; standard viewer PMTiles used for approximate location, orientation and terrain fit.
currentRoundInspection.placement: Inspected entrance picture and retained map geometry set approximate facade, scale and orientation. Standard viewer PMTiles contain a spurious mound under this urban palace. The existing reversible ground-opening mechanism suppresses only the bounded169x170m palace/plaza patch; the model fills it with a reconstructed paved apron atY-21.15, a-21m architecture shift and a2m perimeter taper to the original PMTiles samples. CourtyardY-20.92 and normal-height foundations remain visible. Surrounding terrain is retained and restores on unload. This is approximate visual ground fit, not a surveyed urban datum.
